review_type: Provisional AI author comparison with BSB; not independent editorial review or reader testing
limitations: These records document author comparison against the source. They do not certify interpretation, vocabulary level, accessibility, or learner comprehension. Independent editorial review, intended-reader testing, illustrations, and final presentation validation remain pending.
